rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the human hand.

example.english: I got my hand caught in the door.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 bei2 mun4 gaap3 can1 laa3

rows.note: Use 幫手 as a noun for assistance, especially in phrases such as asking for or thanking someone for their help.

example.english: Thanks for lending a hand this time.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a worker or laborer, especially someone hired for manual work.

example.english: This worker is a good hand at renovation.
example.traditional: 呢個工人係裝修嘅好手。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 jan4 hai6 zong1 sau1 ge3 hou2 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a pointer or hand on a clock, watch, or other dial.

example.english: The clock hand is moving very slowly.
example.jyutping: go3 zung1 ge3 zi2 zam1 juk1 dak1 hou2 maan6
